assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
At least one condition: expression gates a stage or task on branching logic
Condition expressions use Orchestra's ${{ ... }} interpolation syntax rather than a bare Python-style expression

Mutually-exclusive Dagster branches (conditionally-yielded Outs) are modeled as separate stages/tasks each carrying its own condition, not as a single task with inline if/else routing logic ported over
Downstream stages account for a false condition producing a SKIPPED status upstream, rather than assuming the conditioned stage always resolves to SUCCEEDED or FAILED
